scope: Proposition 8.8 (Reduced Bott vanishing) of the manuscript “A torsion-free counterexample to reduced Baum–Connes injectivity” (preprints/A-Torsion-Free-Counterexample-to-Reduced-Baum-Connes-Injectivity-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 285 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 df8d9301aa6d0306), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 80. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For all sufficiently large ν in the chosen compatible sequence, the image of the rank-zero Bott generator of K0(C∗ r (⟨z, x⟩)) is zero integrally in K0(C∗ r (Γν)).
